arguments.sql: SELECT m.id AS merchant_id, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN merchants m ON t.merchant_id = m.id GROUP BY m.id ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, m.id ASC LIMIT 5
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions per merchant and returns the five merchants with the highest counts, highest first, with ties broken by merchant id.
assumptions: All transactions are counted, labelled or not, since the question asks about transactions in general.
Ties in transaction count are ordered by merchant id ascending.
